title: Chapter 309 Joining Forces To Fight Against The Undead Monster
content:
Chapter 309 Joining Forces To Fight Against The Undead Monster

He had never thought that a swordsman could be so fierce.

Of course, the opponent's level was already a junior general, which was the key to his fierceness.

With this person joining, everyone in Changping County was shocked and hope was rekindled in their hearts.

He quickly rushed towards the door of the lord's mansion.

Wherever he passed, the undead fell to the ground.

He really killed one person every ten steps, quite like a sword fairy.

His technique was clean and smooth, and Wang Shuo was stunned.

At this time, he had the idea that killing monsters could be so artistic.

After a few breaths, the undead beast and Xie Xiaofeng arrived near the lord's mansion.

After seeing Xie Xiaofeng, the bloodthirsty demon wolf's heart was also tight.

If I had known earlier, I should have destroyed the lord's mansion first.

In this way, I could control the teleportation array.

But everything was too late.

Xie Xiaofeng's ordinary attack was as high as 1800. If he added internal force or skills, his attack power could be increased several times.

The bloodthirsty demon wolf also had to be cautious.

This is a being that can rival him.

"Leave this bloodthirsty demon wolf to me!"

Lin Xiaodong breathed a sigh of relief.

With Xie Xiaofeng's reinforcement, the people of Changping County felt hopeful again.

Xie Xiaofeng easily dealt with some undead warriors, which made everyone feel his powerful fighting power, and the human coalition was in high spirits.

This is really the unpredictable life, the big intestines are wrapped in the small intestines!

Fate is like this, jumping back and forth between hope and despair.

Lin Xiaodong, who had freed his hands, carefully observed the battlefield situation and immediately chose the undead beast as his new opponent.

He was not unfamiliar with Xie Xiaofeng.

This man was one of the most capable generals under the governor of Hedong County, Zhao, and his fighting power was enough to rank in the top four.

He was in charge of a quarter of the troops under the governor of Zhao.

This time, he came alone to support, and it seemed that the situation in Hedong County was not optimistic.

He was thinking about the situation while analyzing his opponent.

The undead beast has no self-awareness, but is a war weapon pieced together through secret methods.

Although it is extremely powerful and has explosive attack power, it is still easy to be targeted by opponents with high agility.

Lin Xiaodong swung his sword and chopped at the bones on the undead beast, directly cutting off several bones, and then flew away to keep a distance.

At this time, Wang Shuo also quickly killed the opponent around him and joined the battle against the undead beast.

The undead beast also has three highs, but its only disadvantage is that its agility attribute is not enough.

Wang Shuo rode on Da Huang, drilled under the crotch of the undead beast, and cut his calf fiercely.

Several bones were broken at once.

With the agility bonus of the three-headed dog, plus Wang Shuo's own agility attribute.

It is difficult for the undead beast to hit him.

Of course, if he is hit once, it is estimated that he will be GG.

This is equivalent to dancing on the edge of a knife.

Wang Shuo didn't want to face such a dangerous opponent.

But if you don't go, I won't go, someone has to go.

In the war between humans and the undead, Wang Shuo chose to stand up.

"Mayor Wang, I didn't expect you to have such courage to fight the undead beast in person."

Wang Shuo's move attracted Lin Xiaodong's attention, and he admired Wang Shuo's courage.

"County Magistrate Lin, you dare to block the undead beast head-on. I was also moved by your heroic feat, so I ran over to help."

At this time, Wang Shuo really felt a sense of righteousness. When facing another race, there are always some people who will stand in front.
